title: How to use
intro: Short guides for your work. You see only the things you are allowed to do. Tap a title to open it.
none: No guide found. Try another word, or ask us.

signIn.title: Sign in and sign out
steps: Open the app. Type your email and your password. Tap Sign in.
The first time, the app asks you to make a new password. Choose one only you know.
If the app asks for a code, open your code app (or your email) and type the 6 numbers.
Forgot your password? Tap "Forgot password?" on the sign-in page, or ask your manager.
To sign out: tap your picture at the top right, then Sign out.

lockScreen.title: Locked screen and PIN
steps: If nobody uses the app for some minutes, the screen locks. This keeps guest data safe.
To open it again, type your password.
On a shared computer, another person can type their own 4-number PIN. Then the app opens for them.
Set your PIN in My profile (picture at the top right → My profile).

search.title: Find anything fast
steps: Use the search box at the top. Press Ctrl and K together to go there.
Type a guest name, a phone number, a room number or a booking code.
Tap the result to open it.
You can also ask simple questions, like "free rooms" or "who is in room 105".

bell.title: Messages (the bell)
steps: The bell at the top shows new messages for you, like "Room 204 is ready".
A red number means you have new messages.
Tap a message to open the page it is about.

profile.title: My profile and password
steps: Tap your picture at the top right → My profile.
Change your name or phone, then tap Save.
Tap Change password to choose a new password.
Link Telegram if you want to get reports and alerts on your phone.

branch.title: Choose your branch
steps: If your hotel has more than one branch, choose your branch at the top of the page.
All pages then show that branch: rooms, bookings, cleaning.
The app remembers your choice on this computer.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
steps: The Dashboard is the first page. It shows today: guests arriving, guests leaving, free rooms.
The ✨ Smart box gives tips. Tap "Why?" to see how the app knows it.
Tap a number to open the list behind it.

roomBoard.title: Room board (all rooms)
steps: Open Room board in the menu. You see every room as a box.
The color shows the room: green = free, teal = guest inside, orange = dirty, blue = being cleaned, grey = repair. The buttons at the top show each color with its name.
Tap a color button at the top (for example Dirty) to see only those rooms. Tap again to see all.
Use Arriving, Leaving, Overdue or Free tonight to see only those rooms.
A red "Owes" tag means the guest still has money to pay.
Tap a room box to see the guest and to change the room status.

todayLists.title: Who arrives, who leaves today
steps: In Room board, tap Arriving, Leaving or In house at the top.
Arriving = guests who come today. Late = they did not come yet after check-in time.
Leaving = guests who go today. Overdue = they did not leave after check-out time.
In house = all guests who are staying now.

walkIn.title: Walk-in (guest without a booking)
steps: Room board → Walk-in.
Choose Nights, Day use or Hourly. For nights, choose the check-out date.
Tap a free room. You can also choose By room type.
Find the guest by name or phone. If new, tap New guest and fill in the details.
Check the price on the right side.
Choose how the guest pays (Cash, telebirr…) and type the amount. You can add a photo of the payment.
Tap Take payment and check in. The room is now taken.

quickCheckIn.title: Quick check-in (no time for details)
steps: On the Walk-in page, tick Quick check-in.
Type only the guest name and phone.
Take the payment and check in.
The guest gets a "Details missing" mark. Add the ID details later, when you have time.
The app reminds you if you forget.

newBooking.title: Make a booking (for another day)
steps: Reservations → New reservation.
Choose the dates: check-in and check-out.
Add the rooms the guest wants. The app shows only rooms that are free.
Find or add the guest.
Choose how the guest booked (phone, email…). Add a note if needed.
Tap Book. If the hotel asks for a deposit, the booking waits until the deposit is paid.

freeRooms.title: Is a room free on a date?
steps: Reservations → Calendar. Each line is a room, each column is a day.
A colored bar is a booking. Move your mouse on it (or tap it) to see the guest and the dates.
An empty place means the room is free that day.
Tap a day at the top to see all rooms for that day.

checkIn.title: Check in a guest with a booking
steps: Room board → Arriving. Tap the guest.
Tap Check in.
Choose a clean room for each booked room.
Check the guest's ID. If the hotel asks, take a photo of the ID.
If money is still needed, take the payment.
Before the check-in time, the app may add an early check-in fee. You can choose Don't charge if you are allowed.
Tap Check in. The bill opens by itself.

moveExtend.title: Move room or stay longer
steps: Open the guest's booking. Tap Move / extend.
To move: choose the new room and tap Move. The old room becomes dirty.
To stay longer: choose the new check-out date and tap Extend. The price is added to the bill.
If the room is booked by someone else, move the guest to another room first.

checkOut.title: Check out a guest
steps: Room board → Leaving. Tap the guest, then Check out.
Need to add something (minibar, laundry)? Tap Add charge first.

After the check-out time, a late fee may be added. Leaving before the booked date: the nights not used come off the bill, and an early check-out fee may be added. You can choose Don't charge if you are allowed.
The app shows "To pay". Take the money.
If the guest cannot pay now, a manager can let them leave with money owed.
Tap Check out. The room becomes dirty, and cleaning starts.

changeBooking.title: Change a booking
steps: Open the booking. Tap Edit.
Change the dates, rooms or guests.
The price is worked out again. The deposit stays on the booking.
Tap Save.

cancelBooking.title: Cancel a booking
steps: Open the booking. Tap Cancel booking.
The app shows if cancelling is free or if there is a fee (the hotel's rule).
Write the reason. Tap Cancel booking.
If the guest gets money back, a manager gives it back as a refund.

noShow.title: Guest did not come (no-show)
steps: Only after the check-in time has passed.
Open the booking. Tap Mark no-show.
The hotel's no-show fee is taken from the deposit. The room is free again.

guests.title: Guests: add and change
steps: Open Guests in the menu. Search by name, phone or ID.
Tap New guest to add one. Name and phone are the most important.
Tap a guest to see their stays, bills and notes, and to change their details.
The app warns you if the same guest already exists. Please do not add the same guest two times.

idPhoto.title: Photo of the guest's ID or passport
steps: Only if your hotel turned this on.
Open the guest, or the check-in screen. Tap Take photo, or Choose file.
Hold the ID flat, with good light. Check that the words can be read.
The photo is kept safe and locked. Only staff who can see guests can open it.

blacklist.title: Block a guest (blacklist)
steps: Open the guest. Tap Add to blacklist and write the reason.
A blocked guest cannot be booked or checked in. Staff see the reason.
To remove it, tap Remove from blacklist on the same page.

takePayment.title: Take a payment
steps: Open the booking or the bill. Tap Record payment.
Choose how the guest pays: Cash, telebirr, CBE Birr, bank…
Type the amount. For telebirr or bank, type the transaction number in Reference.
Tap Save payment.
If the amount is more than the guest owes, the app asks "Is that right?". Check the number before you say yes.

paymentProof.title: Photo of the payment (proof)
steps: When you take a payment, you can add a photo: a telebirr screen, a bank slip.
Tap Take photo, or Choose file.
Later, tap Add proof next to a payment to add it after.
The proof helps when someone asks about the payment.

extraCharge.title: Add an extra charge (laundry, food…)
steps: Open the guest's bill: Billing, or the bill number on the booking. You can also do it at check-out.
Tap Add charge.
Choose the charge (for example Laundry), or choose Other and write what it is.
Type how many and the price each. Tap Add charge.
It goes on the bill. The guest pays it with the rest.

discount.title: Give a discount
steps: Open the bill. Tap Add discount.
Type the percent (%) and the reason.
Your role has a highest discount. Bigger discounts need a manager.

printBill.title: Print a bill or receipt
steps: Open the bill. Tap Print.
Choose A4 paper, or the small 80 mm receipt printer.
Print. Give the paper to the guest.

refund.title: Give money back (refund)
steps: Open the booking or the bill. Tap Record payment.
Choose Refund, how the money goes back, and the amount.
Write the reason. Tap Save payment.
You cannot give back more than the guest paid.

cancelBill.title: Cancel a bill
steps: Only when the bill is wrong. Open the bill. Tap Cancel bill.
Write the reason.
The bill stays in the records with the word CANCELLED. Give back any money as a refund.
The Hotel Admin is told when a paid bill is cancelled.

unpaid.title: Guest leaves without paying everything
steps: At check-out, tick "the guest leaves with this money unpaid".
The money stays as owed, on the guest and in the reports.
When the guest pays later, open the bill and tap Record payment.

cashierShift.title: My cash drawer (cashier shift)
steps: At the start of work: Cashier shift → count the money in the drawer → type it → Open shift.
All cash you take is added to your shift.
At the end of work: count the drawer again and type it.
The app shows if it matches. If it is short or over, write why.
Tap Close shift. A manager checks it.

approveShift.title: Check a cash drawer (manager)
steps: Cashier shift → All cashier shifts. Tap a closed shift.
See what should be in the drawer, what was counted, and the reason for any difference.
Tap Approve when it is OK. Talk to the person if something is wrong.

roomStatus.title: Change a room's status
steps: Room board → tap the room.
Tap the new status: Available (clean and ready), Dirty, or Cleaning.
A dirty room gets a cleaning task by itself.

maintenance.title: Room needs repair
steps: Room board → tap the room → Maintenance, or Out of order.
The room cannot be booked or given to a guest.
When the repair is done, set it back to Available.

cleaning.title: Clean rooms (my tasks)
steps: Open Housekeeping → My tasks. You see the rooms to clean, the most urgent first.
Tap Start when you begin a room.
Tap Done when the room is clean. You can write a note, for example "broken lamp".
The room becomes ready, and reception sees it at once.

assignCleaning.title: Give cleaning work to people
steps: Housekeeping → Assign tasks.
Choose the room, the task (Cleaning, Inspection, Maintenance), how urgent, and the person.
Tap Add task. The person sees it in their list.
Rooms tab: see all rooms and who is cleaning which room.

clockIn.title: Start and end my work time
steps: Open Attendance. Tap Clock in when you start work.
Tap Clock out when you finish.
On the shared kiosk tablet, type your PIN instead.
Set your kiosk PIN on the Attendance page.

myShifts.title: When do I work?
steps: Open Shifts and attendance. You see your shifts for the week.
Ask your manager if you need to change a day.

roster.title: Plan the staff week (roster)
steps: Shifts and attendance → Shifts: make the shift times (for example Morning 07:00–15:00).
Roster: choose a day and a shift, then add the people.
Staff see their shifts in their own page.
The app warns you if a day has too few people.

paperAttendance.title: Add attendance by hand
steps: For days without the app or kiosk.
Attendance → Enter from the paper register.
Choose the person and the date. Type the time in and out, or choose Absent or Leave.
Tap Save.

reports.title: Reports
steps: Open Reports. Choose a report on the left, for example Daily report.
Choose the dates at the top: today, this week, this month…
Tap a bar in a chart to see the bookings behind it.
Tap Print, or download Excel, to share it.

myReport.title: My work report
steps: Open Reports. You see your own work: today, this week and this month.
Receptionists see their check-ins, payments and cash. Housekeepers see their cleaned rooms.

approvals.title: Approve requests
steps: Open Approvals. You see things that wait for a manager, like a big discount.
Read the request. Tap Approve, or Reject with a reason.
The person who asked is told at once.

staff.title: Add staff
steps: Staff → Add staff.
Type the name and email. Choose the role (what they can do) and their branch.
Tap Add staff member. The app makes a first password. Give it to the person; they change it the first time.
Forgot password? Open the person → Reset password.
Someone left the hotel? Open the person → Disable account. Do not share accounts.

roles.title: Roles: who can do what
steps: Roles and permissions. Each role is a list of things a person can do.
Tap a role to change it, or New role to make one.
Tick what the role can do. Set the highest discount.
Everyone with that role gets the change at once.

devices.title: Computers and phones that use the app
steps: Open Devices. You see every computer and phone that signed in.
A new device can wait for your OK (if your hotel turned this on). Tap Approve or Block.
Lost a phone? Tap Sign out next to it.

settings.title: Hotel settings
steps: Open Settings. Use the search box to find a setting fast.
Hotel: name, logo, tax numbers (they are on the bills).
Rooms: room types, prices and rooms. Prices: weekend and season prices.
Booking rules: deposit, fees, the time a night starts, ID photo.
Money: currencies, exchange rates, taxes, payment methods.
Each page has a short help text at the top.

activity.title: Who did what (activity log)
steps: Open Activity log. Every important action is written here: who, what and when.
Search by person, or by word, for example "refund".
Nobody can delete this list.
